description: Use this when the user wants a weekly schedule maker, class schedule maker, college schedule builder, time blocking template or work schedule template: a printable week grid PDF from a list of recurring blocks (title, days, start-end time, optional location and colour), with each overlap listed (day and minutes overlapped), hours per title and per day, free gaps of 30+ minutes, and an .ics calendar file with one weekly repeating event per block (term start to term end, time zone aware, skip dates). Accepts sloppy text such as "Calc MWF 9-10:15am" or "Gym Tuesdays and Thursdays 7-8am". Does not handle alternate-week or one-off events, does not read files or screenshots, and does not plan shift rotations between people.

blocks.description: The weekly blocks: classes, shifts, workouts, focus time. Either one line per block as text, e.g. "Calculus MWF 9-10:15am Room 204\nBiology Lab Tue 2-5pm\nGym Tuesdays and Thursdays 7-8am", or a list of objects like {"title":"Calculus","days":"MWF","start":"9:00","end":"10:15am","location":"Room 204","color":"blue"}. Days accept MWF, M/W/F, TTh, TR, Tue Thu, Tuesdays and Thursdays, weekdays, Mon-Fri, weekends, daily. Times accept 9-10:15am, 9am to 10.15, 14:00-15:30, noon-1pm, 10pm-6am (overnight).

clock.description: Time format: 12h (default, 9:00 AM) or 24h (09:00), e.g. 24h. Default follows the input style.

day_end.description: Optional end of the day window used for free time, e.g. 6pm. Default: the latest block end.

day_start.description: Optional start of the day window used for free time, e.g. 8am. Default: the earliest block start.

days_shown.description: Which days get a column: auto (default: Mon-Fri, plus the weekend when a block falls on it), weekdays, or all, e.g. all.

orientation.description: Page orientation: landscape (default) or portrait, e.g. portrait.

paper.description: Paper size for the PDF: letter (default in the US and Canada) or A4, e.g. A4.

skip_dates.description: Dates with no sessions (holidays, breaks), left out of the calendar file, e.g. "Nov 25 - Nov 27, Sep 7" or ["2026-11-26","2026-11-27"].

term_end.description: For the calendar file: last day of the term, e.g. 2026-12-11. Each block repeats weekly until this day. Default: repeats with no end date.

term_start.description: For the calendar file: first day of the term or schedule, e.g. 2026-08-24 or Aug 24 2026. Default: today.

time_zone.description: For the calendar file: the time zone or city of the schedule, e.g. America/New_York or Chicago. Default: floating local times (no zone).

title.description: Heading on the printout, e.g. Fall 2026 classes. Default: Weekly schedule.

week_start.description: First day of the week in the grid: Monday (default) or Sunday, e.g. Sunday.

name: generate_weekly_schedule
title: Generate weekly schedule
